payload.title: Cross-fitted legal residual action
payload.statement: A small model trained only inside each fold can combine test-available geometry, visible-prefix evidence, E006 predictions, and E007 self-correlation diagnostics to learn a bounded signed residual correction that improves E006 without the fixed E007 shift failures.
payload.evidence_for: E006 proves controlled fusion is useful, while E007 exposes an independent low-correlation GR signal whose fixed placement improves pooled RMSE but needs learned regime-sensitive actuation.
payload.evidence_against: E003 shows that risk detection is easier than signed action, and E007 visible pseudo-gain does not reliably protect long, missing-GR, spatial, or typewell regimes.
payload.next_test: E008: pre-register a compact cross-fitted datum/trend or bounded path-residual model, candidate/evidence feature contract, shuffle controls, repeated folds, spatial/typewell stress, tail gates, and final-placement comparison against E006.
